title: Tenpay go review (Just traveler)
text: I went to China a few days ago. My WeChat accounts are registered with a VISA card and Apple Pay, respectively. However, the VISA card did not work properly, and an error occurred. So I searched the internet and found the Tenpay Go app. It is much more convenient and works better than a regular VISA card. However, a couple of times—2 or 3 times—I had an embarrassing experience for no apparent reason: money was paid from my Apple Pay-linked account, but the store’s system didn’t show the payment, so I had to pay in cash. However, fortunately, it was refunded later. I definitely want to use Tenpay Go on my next trip to China, and I hope this app works without any errors. It seems like a really good app. Thank you for making it.

title: Evaluation&handbook/测评与使用指南
text:
界面：
整体相当精简。完美适配 Apple Pay，也支持直接绑定主流国际信用卡（Visa/Mastercard）。支付操作灵活，既能向商家出示付款码，也支持主动扫描商家的收款码。
注册：
流程极简，体验非常友好。仅需邮箱加设置 PIN 码即可完成，完全无需繁琐的 KYC（身份实名）认证，真正做到了开箱即用。
使用范围：
仅限中国大陆境内商户使用，暂不支持向个人收款码转账。不过，由于国内日常消费场景（餐饮、零售、出行等）绝大多数都是商户码，因此实际线下消费基本不受影响，完全能满足日常出行需求。
费率：
单笔消费在 200 RMB 以下免收国际卡手续费；200 RMB 及以上则需加收 3% 的手续费。
总评：
总体而言，这是一款注册零门槛、日常覆盖广的便捷支付工具。它完美解决了海外用户在境内“支付难”的痛点，是短期来华旅游、探亲或出差的境外用户首选的轻量支付App。

Interface:
Clean and minimalist. It works seamlessly with Apple Pay and also allows you to link a bank card (Visa/Mastercard) for payments. You can either present your payment QR code to merchants or scan their codes to pay.
Registration:
Hassle-free—only requires an email address and a PIN setup. No KYC (Know Your Customer) verification is required, which is extremely convenient.
Usage Scope:
Restricted to merchants in mainland China; peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers to personal QR codes are not supported. However, since almost all QR codes encountered for daily spending are merchant codes, it functions smoothly for everyday use.
Fees:
International card transaction fees are waived for amounts under 200 RMB. A 3% fee applies to transactions of 200 RMB and above.
Overall Verdict:
A highly practical payment app featuring an easy registration process and broad daily acceptance. It is a fantastic, hassle-free digital wallet tailored primarily for international travelers visiting mainland China.
